items.headline: ICJ: Myanmar ne Rohingya ka narsanhar kiya
items.detail: ICJ ne 9-6 ke faisle me kaha Myanmar ki sena ne 2017 me uttari Rakhine me Rohingya ka narsanhar kiya, kam se kam 10,000 log mare gaye; adaalat ne marammat aur surakshit wapsi ka aadesh diya.
items.exam_angle: ICJ, Genocide Convention, Rohingya — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: International Court of Justice, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Russia ka Ukraine par sabse bada hawai hamla
items.detail: Russia ne raat bhar 400 se zyada drone aur 110 se zyada missile daage, Kyiv ke teen pulon aur bijli dhanchon ko nishana banaya; aath log mare gaye aur lagbhag 30 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kerch Bridge — UPSC IR

items.headline: Pannun sajish: Gupta ko 19 saal ki saza
items.detail: New York ki federal adaalat ne Nikhil Gupta ko Gurpatwant Singh Pannun ki hatya ki sajish me 235 mahine ki saza sunayi; Gupta ne February me aarop kabool kiye the.
items.exam_angle: Pannun mamla, Bharat-America sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ukraine vaarta me Europe ko bhi jagah milegi
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne kaha paanch European desh, EU aur NATO aane wali Russia vaarta me shamil honge; Trump ne Berlin me Coalition of the Willing ki baithak me phone par hissa liya.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine vaarta, Coalition of the Willing — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump-Xi-Putin ki pehli tri-pakshiya shikhar vaarta
items.detail: Shenzhen me pehli baar America, China aur Russia ke netaon ne chaar-sutri shanti ghoshna par hastakshar kiye — UN sudhar, tel aapurti, ICC aur parmanu jokhim par samvaad; Ukraine aur Iran ka zikr nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Trilateral summit, UN sudhar, parmanu jokhim — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: President of Russia (Kremlin.ru), CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Trump ko January tak Ukraine shanti samjhauta chahiye
items.detail: Financial Times ki report ke anusar Trump prashasan chahta hai Ukraine-Russia shanti samjhauta January 2027 ki shuruaat tak ho, Democrats ke Congress sambhalne se pehle; Witkoff aur Kushner ne Moscow, Dublin aur Berlin me vaarta ki.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, US Congress — UPSC IR

items.headline: Denmark ne rapper-hatya sajish nakam ki
items.detail: Denmark ne kaha uski police ne September me Copenhagen me US-Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner ki hatya ki koshish nakam ki, jisme Russia ki khufiya seva ka haath bataya gaya; teen log giraftar hue aur Russia ke raksha attache ko nikal diya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Denmark, khufiya seva — UPSC IR

items.headline: Malaysia ne Bharatiyon ki visa-mukt pravesh band ki
items.detail: Malaysia ne kaha 1 January 2027 se Bharatiya nagrikon ko visa-mukt pravesh nahi milega; pehle se visa lena hoga, MyVISA portal par aavedan 1 December 2026 se shuru honge.
items.exam_angle: Malaysia visa niti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Putin ne Europe ko Moscow bulaya
items.detail: Putin ne kaha Europe ke doot Moscow aakar Ukraine vaarta par apna rukh saaf karein; Ryabkov ke anusar Britain, France aur Germany ke pratinidhiyon ki yatra par kaam chal raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, Europe ki bhumika — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza hamla khatm, log wapas laute
items.detail: Israel ki sena ne kaha madhya Gaza me tankon wala zameeni operation khatm hua; Nuseirat shivir ke log wapas lautne lage aur Salah al-Din sadak phir khul gayi.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram, Yellow Line — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kenya Ebola-mukt ki ore, aakhri mareez chhuta
items.detail: Kenya ne apna aakhri Ebola mareez chhutti de di; saaton mareez theek hue aur 135 sampark wale logon ki nigrani poori hui, 23 December tak koi naya case na aaya to desh Ebola-mukt ghoshit hoga.
items.exam_angle: Ebola, WHO 42-din niyam — UPSC Health

items.headline: Russia ne NATO-jaisi guarantee kharij ki
items.detail: Russia ke up-videsh mantri Ryabkov ne kaha Ukraine ko NATO ke Article 5 jaisi suraksha guarantee ya 'quasi-membership' bilkul manzoor nahi; Kushner ne ek din pehle dawa kiya tha ki Russia is vichar se sahmat hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, NATO Article 5 — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kyiv hamle me dootavas, girjaghar kshatigrast
items.detail: Russia ke din ke drone hamle me Kyiv me ek vyakti mara aur paanch ghayal hue; Austria aur Netherlands ke dootavas aur St Volodymyr Cathedral ki khidkiyan tooti.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, rajnaitik suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: TSMC-Samsung ne China ko chip roki
items.detail: America ke naye niryat niyam ke baad TSMC aur Samsung ne China ke grahakon ko kuch advanced chip ki delivery roki; 16nm se neeche ki takneek ke liye ab US licence chahiye.
items.exam_angle: US-China chip war, export controls — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: America ne Ukraine-NATO sadasyata ka vikalp uthaya
items.detail: Wall Street Journal ke anusar America ke doot Kushner aur Witkoff ne band kamre ki baatchit me sujhav diya ki Ukraine bacha hua Donbas Russia ko de to use NATO ki poorna sadasyata mil sakti hai; Zelenskyy ne kaha Ukraine zameen nahi chhodega.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, NATO vistar — UPSC IR

items.headline: RAF Fairford mamle me 2027 me mukadma
items.detail: London ki adalat ne RAF Fairford sainya adde par September ki ghatna ke do aaropiyon ka mukadma 22 November 2027 se tay kiya; abhiyojakon ke anusar ye Iran ke hit me ki gayi thi, dono ne dosh na manne ka sanket diya hai.
items.exam_angle: Britain-Iran tanav, rashtriya suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Pakistan me chhapo me 22 atankwadi mare
items.detail: Pakistan ki fauj ne Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke Dakshin Waziristan, Bannu aur Tank jilon me chhapon ke dauran 22 atankwadiyon ko marne ka dawa kiya; fauj ne aarop lagaya ki ve Bharat ke samarthan wale sangathan se jude the.
items.exam_angle: Pakistan me atankwad-virodhi karwai, Bharat-Pak tanav — UPSC IR

items.headline: Voyager 1 dharti se ek light-day door
items.detail: NASA ka Voyager 1 pehli manav-nirmit vastu bana jo dharti se ek light-day — lagbhag 2,600 crore km — door pahuncha; is doori par radio sanket ko ek taraf jaane me poore 24 ghante lagte hain.
items.exam_angle: NASA, antariksh anveshan — UPSC Science & Tech

items.headline: Poland me Russian missile giri, NATO madad
items.detail: Poland ke raksha mantri ne kaha Russia ki do Kh-101 missile aur ek jet-powered drone Ukraine par hamle ke dauran Poland ke andar gire; koi hatahat nahi hua, lekin Poland ne NATO se atirikt sainya madad maangi hai.
items.exam_angle: NATO airspace violation, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Estonia ne Russia seema chhah mahine band ki
items.detail: Estonia 1 December se Russia ke saath apne paanchon sadak seema-par kam se kam chhah mahine ke liye band karega — raksha company par sandehspad aagajani ke baad suraksha karan; Russia ne ise 'Iron Curtain' batakar jawab dene ki dhamki di.
items.exam_angle: Baltic suraksha, NATO-Russia tanav — UPSC IR

items.headline: IMF: duniya ka karz GDP ke 100% tak
items.detail: IMF pramukh Kristalina Georgieva ne Shenzhen me APEC shikhar par chetavni di ki vaishvik sarkari karz jald duniya ki GDP ke 100% tak pahunch jayega — Dusre Vishwa Yuddh ke baad sabse uncha star; vaishvik mehengaai 4.7% rehne ka anumaan hai.
items.exam_angle: Vaishvik karz, IMF, APEC — UPSC Economy

items.headline: Trump ne Iran hamle ka faisla taal diya
items.detail: Trump ne Reuters aur Axios se kaha Iran par dobara hamle ka faisla naye saal ke baad hoga — 'jaldi nahi hai'; Netanyahu turant bombing ke liye dabav bana rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran yuddh aur West Asia ki sthiti — UPSC/PCS ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Europe me yuvaon ki badi hadtaal
items.detail: 25 se zyada deshon me hazaaron yuva sadkon par utre — mehengaai, awaas aur shiksha ke liye paise, hathiyaron par kharch band karne ki maang; Italy me aam hadtaal, Britain me 350 se zyada school-college band.
items.exam_angle: Europe me yuva andolan aur sainya kharch par bahas — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye.

items.headline: Iraqi fauj Kataib Hezbollah ke gadh me
items.detail: Iraqi sarkari faujon ne shukravar ko Jurf al-Sakher me Kataib Hezbollah ke gadh me pravesh kiya, tel-taskari ke aarop par hue tanav ke baad hue samjhaute ke tahat, bina kisi sangharsh ke.
items.exam_angle: Iraq-Iran proxy sangharsh — UPSC IR
